While costs are through the roof, what has the president been focused on?

-Fighting a war costing taxpayers billions of dollars.

-Building a billion-dollar ballroom and an arch dedicated to himself.

Not lowering your costs.

Trump’s war with Iran has cost Americans more than $42 billion in gas and diesel costs. That’s more than $300 per family. Not peanuts.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

Trump on high gas prices: "This is peanuts. I appreciate everybody putting up with it for a little while. But I don't even think about. What I think about is you can't let Iran have a nuclear weapon."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/atrupar/status/2056752936584114197#m

33 years at KDWB and never more than a week off — what a run! Congrats on your retirement Dave!


The Minnesota Star Tribune (@StarTribune)

Twin Cities radio legend Dave Ryan is retiring after 33 years on the air at KDWB. The host announced his last day at the station will be May 22. startribune.com/dave-ryan-kd…




— https://nitter.net/StarTribune/status/2054558346242388061#m

They’re blocking a vote that would’ve reined in the President’s unauthorized war with Iran.

Congress needs to do its job and assert its constitutional authority to end this war that has already cost Americans more than $42 billion in higher fuel costs.

In 2024, 564 Minnesotans lost their lives to gun violence.

And last year, two little kids’ lives were taken in the Annunciation shooting months after Melissa and Mark Hortman were killed in their own home.

We need action on common-sense gun legislation. I will always fight to keep Minnesotans safe.

A good way to end the night and begin the day. And they had us at “hello!” Thanks for a great run Stephen Colbert!


Spencer Althouse (@SpencerAlthouse)

this was so sweet. Stephen Colbert just ended his final episode of The Late Show while singing "Hello, Goodbye" with Paul McCartney. his family and the show's crew then joined them on stage before Paul turned off the lights to the Ed Sullivan Theater

For 11 years, Stephen Colbert has brought humor and heart to late-night television. It was a privilege to join him on that stage. Thank you, Stephen, and wishing you all the best in your next chapter.

U.S. Senator Bill Cassidy, M.D. (@SenBillCassidy)

People are concerned about paying their mortgage or rent, affording groceries and paying for gas, not about putting together a $1.8 billion fund for the President and his allies to pay whomever they wish with no legal precedent or accountability. This is adding to our national debt. If there needs

Justice served. Minnesotans deserve this accountability. 

Thanks to the prosecutors and investigators who worked on this case.


The Associated Press (@AP)

Together, we can and will do more to make housing affordable for all Minnesotans.

NEWS: The Senate voted today to put a check on President Trump’s power — and give Congress the say in bringing his war in Iran to an end.

I’m grateful to all my colleagues, including 4 Republicans, who joined us in reaffirming Congress’s constitutional authority over going to war.

Minnesotans deserve a government that can carry its weight and match their drive and ambition.

If you give me the opportunity to serve as your governor, I will work every day to build a government that solves problems and delivers results for the people it serves.

Now my bipartisan Rural Broadband Protection Act has been signed into law — making sure funding goes to providers who can get the job done.
